name: b10 — a rupee-exact invoice rounds to itself
workings: One pharmacy line, base 5000 at 1200 bps. taxHead(5000, 1200) = divHalfUp(6,000,000, 20,000) = floor((12,000,000 + 20,000) / 40,000) = floor(300.5) = 300 per head, netPaise = 5000 + 300 + 300 = 5600 — already a whole rupee. roundTotalToRupee(5600) = divHalfUp(5600, 100) x 100 = floor((11,200 + 100) / 200) x 100 = floor(56.5) x 100 = 5600, so roundingPaise is 0 and netPayable equals rawTotal. The §170 line on the printed invoice reads zero; an implementation that always nudged the total would show it.
